summary: The task involved analyzing pharmacy refill policy comparing 90-day vs 100-day cycles (not 30-day vs 90-day as in the existing skill). The agent failed because it calculated 'revenue' instead of 'margin' (reimbursement - drug cost - packaging cost), and used incorrect field names in the JSON output. The verifier expected margin-based calculations with specific field names like 'margin_difference_90_minus_30_usd' but got revenue-based calculations. This reveals a broader pattern: refill cycle analysis tasks can have different cycle lengths (30/90, 90/100, etc.), different cost structures (vials vs canisters), and different patient counts. The existing skill is too narrowly scoped to 30/90 day inhaled therapies with 240 patients. I need to generalize the skill to handle variant cycle lengths, cost structures, and ensure correct margin calculation terminology.
